ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. Used as a fallback accessibility label when the section has no visible heading.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionAriaLabel.helper: Optional. Used only when no visible section heading is provided.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the article layout.

SectionHeadingElement.helper: Choose the heading level that fits the page outline.

IssueLabel.helper: Optional. Short label shown on the right side of the section header.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading.
IntroText.placeholder: Explore the latest analysis, implementation guidance, and engineering perspectives.

FeaturedArticle.helper: Large left-side article card. The entire card links when a safe URL is provided.

Category.helper: Optional. Category label shown as a pill over the image.

Title.placeholder: Designing Systems for Long-Term Technical Clarity

Description.placeholder: A practical look at architecture decisions, delivery constraints, and maintainable implementation patterns.

Image.helper: Featured article image. If no image is selected, the card still renders with a readable dark background.

ImageAlt.helper: Describe meaningful image content. Leave empty only when the image is decorative.
ImageAlt.placeholder: Engineering team reviewing a technical architecture diagram

ImageFocalPosition.helper: Controls the image object-position used inside the featured card.

CtaText.helper: Optional. Visible call-to-action text shown inside the card.

Url.helper: Allowed URL formats: anchors, slash-relative URLs, http, https, mailto, and tel. Protocol-relative URLs are rejected.

LinkTarget.helper: Choose whether the card opens in the current tab or a new tab.

CtaAriaLabel.helper: Optional. More descriptive label for screen readers.

SideArticles.helper: Add smaller right-side article cards in display order. Each card links when a safe URL is provided.

Category.helper: Optional. Eyebrow label shown above the title.

Description.placeholder: A focused checklist for validating assumptions before production rollout.
